footnote_text: Pursuant to the Agreement and Plan of Merger, dated September 29, 2025, by and among Clywedog Therapeutics Holdings, Inc. (formerly known as Beacon Topco, Inc.) (the "Issuer"), Barinthus Biotherapeutics plc, Cdog Merger Sub, Inc. and Clywedog Therapeutics, Inc. ("Clywedog") (as amended, the "Merger Agreement"), each share of common stock and each share of series seed preferred stock of Clywedog beneficially owned by the Reporting Person at the effective time of the transactions contemplated by the Merger Agreement was exchanged for (i) 0.741416 shares of common stock of the Issuer and (ii) an amount in cash for which any fractional shares of the Issuer to which the Reporting Person would be entitled sold on the open market.
